template.title: Signature template
template.noneHint: Choose a template in Signature templates for a styled box.

level.title: Signature level
level.bb: B-B: basic signature. Proves integrity; no timestamp.
level.bt: B-T: adds a timestamp from a TSA server, proving when it was signed.
level.blt: B-LT: adds revocation data (CRL/OCSP) so it can be checked later offline.
level.blta: B-LTA: adds a document timestamp for long-term validity.
level.needTsa: This level needs at least one TSA server. Add one in Settings.

certify.warning: Certification restricts later changes. Use it only for the first signature of a document.
